picker.description: Follow the public Instagram profiles of a client, its competitors and prospects, and see how they post.
picker.empty: There are no clients yet. <link>Add one</link> first.
picker.profiles: {count, plural, =0 {No profiles yet} one {# profile} other {# profiles}}

home.heading: Instagram profiles of {client}
home.description: Add the profiles to follow. Forgecy reads them and shows how often they post, what they post and what changes.

add.title: Add a profile
add.description: Paste the link or the @name of a public Instagram business profile. It is read right away.

list.title: Followed profiles
list.empty: No profiles yet. Add the first one above.
list.posts: {count, plural, one {# post stored} other {# posts stored}}
list.removeConfirm: Stop following @{handle}? What was read from it is deleted.

source.none: Reading Instagram profiles is switched off on this installation (FORGECY_SOCIAL_PUBLIC_WEB=false in the .env file) and no Graph API token is set.
source.blocked: Instagram asked for a login or a check on the source “{source}”, so reading from it is stopped.

benchmark.title: Side by side
benchmark.description: The same measures for every profile that was read. The best value in each column is marked.
benchmark.vsUsNote: The smaller figure under a value is the difference from our client.
benchmark.warning: These profiles were read from different sources or at different times, so the comparison is only approximate.
benchmark.noSelf: Mark one profile as “Our client” to see how the others differ from it.

profile.neverRead: Not read yet. Use “Read now” to get the first numbers.

cards.basis: {count, plural, one {Based on # post} other {Based on # posts}}, from {from} to {to}
cards.basisMetrics: {count, plural, =0 {No post has both likes and comments} one {Based on # post with likes and comments} other {Based on # posts with likes and comments}}

cadence.title: When they post
cadence.heatmap: Posts by weekday and hour, {timeZone} time
cadence.cell: {weekday} {hour}: {count, plural, =0 {no posts} one {# post} other {# posts}}
cadence.noBest: There are not enough posts to find the best times.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.summary: {withTags, plural, one {# post uses hashtags} other {# posts use hashtags}}, {avg} per post on average, {distinct} different ones.
hashtags.none: No hashtags in the posts read.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.none: No post has both likes and comments.

captions.title: Captions
captions.question: With a question
captions.none: No captions in the posts read.

relations.title: Who they work with
relations.none: No relationships found in the posts read.

events.title: What changed
events.empty: No changes yet. The first reading is the starting point.

external_url.changed: The link in the bio changed
external_url.added: A link was added to the bio
external_url.removed: The link was removed from the bio

errors.invalidHandle: That is not an Instagram profile. Paste the link or the @name.
errors.duplicateProfile: @{handle} is already followed for this client.
errors.tooManyProfiles: A client can follow at most {max} profiles.
errors.noSource: No reading source is available: reading Instagram profiles is switched off in this installation.
errors.snapshotInProgress: This profile is already being read.
errors.sourceBlocked: Instagram asked for a login or a check, so reading is stopped until an Admin resumes it.
errors.queueUnavailable: The job queue is not available right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.notAnInstagramChannel: Only Instagram channels can be read this way.

status.blocked: Instagram asked for a login or a check. Reading is stopped until an Admin resumes it.
status.apiDrift: Instagram changed its response. The reader needs an update.
status.transport: Instagram could not be reached. It will be tried again.
status.rateLimited: Too many requests. It will be tried again later.
status.private: This profile is private, so nothing can be read.
status.notFound: No public profile with this name.
status.unauthorized: The Graph API token is missing or was refused.
status.noSource: No reading source is available: reading Instagram profiles is switched off in this installation.
status.notBusiness: This account is not a business or creator account, so the Graph API cannot read it.
